resources.string: Preview and apply a style for the instrument cluster. Changing styles reconnects CarPlay.
Choose a cluster style. Previews are static illustrations; actual content appears after connection.
Red concentric instruments with a vehicle scene, music and a right-side CarPlay map.
Twin dials with vehicle information, a central CarPlay map and music.
The original CarPlay map projection, without DiPlay’s custom dials.
